items.title: Banks escalate stablecoin rewards fight as Senate prepares for a Clarity Act vote
Crypto Market Has 'Definitely Not Priced In' Clarity Act Surprise, Says Bernstein
items.summary: Ethics and banking concessions have improved the crypto bill’s prospects, analysts say, but Democratic support remains uncertain.

items.title: Strategy Buys Back $139 Million of STRC, Bitcoin Stack Frozen for Second Week
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm slowed its preferred-stock buyback from last week's $176 million pace and left its 845,050 BTC untouched, per a Monday SEC filing.
